newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to meet leaders of Spain and Portugal. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Clinton to meet leaders of Spain and Portugal. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will meet the leaders of Spain and Portugal at the White House in April, a spokesman announced on Friday.

Clinton's meeting with Portuguese Prime Minister Antonio Guterres is scheduled for Apr. 3 and his meeting with Spanish Prime Minister (corrects title from President) Jose Maria Aznar is set for Apr. 30, White House spokesman Mike McCurry said in a statement.
